title: Settings
description: Configure your server settings, manage SFTP access, and access debug information. Make changes to server name and reinstall when needed.
sftp_password_note: Your SFTP password is the same as the password you use to access this panel.
reinstall_confirm_description: Your server will be stopped and some files may be deleted or modified during this process, are you sure you wish to continue?
reinstall_description: Reinstalling your server will stop it, and then re-run the installation script that initially set it up.
reinstall_warning: Some files may be deleted or modified during this process, please back up your data before continuing.
reinstall_started: Your server has begun the reinstallation process.
